aliases: Stadtwerke Bamberg Verkehrs- und Park GmbH

officialEvidence.networkScope: Public charging stations operated by Stadtwerke Bamberg in Bamberg and named surrounding municipal sites.
officialEvidence.directPayment: Official page states spontaneous ad-hoc charging is available at all stations by scanning the QR code.
officialEvidence.blockingScope: Official page explicitly exempts P+R Heinrichsdamm and P+R Kronacher Straße from LadeverbundPlus/ad-hoc blocking fees all day, while several parking facilities state that a blocking fee applies after four hours; the current public page does not publish the exact ad-hoc blocking-fee amount for those facilities.

identityEvidence.policy: DE*LVP is a shared LadeverbundPlus prefix and is not promoted to an exclusive Bamberg alias.

discoveryConflict.note: Current third-party station discovery data shows 0.70 EUR/kWh on some Bamberg DE*LVP stations, while the current operator page states 0.62 EUR/kWh ad-hoc. Third-party values are retained only as a lead and are not promoted over the operator source.
discoveryConflict.neededToClose: An operator-controlled QR/direct-payment payload for representative current Bamberg EVSEs, or an official current tariff sheet that resolves the per-site blocking fee and confirms whether the 0.62 EUR/kWh ad-hoc energy price applies uniformly during the September 2026 LadeverbundPlus transition.

decision: Keep partial/fail-closed: exact official ad-hoc energy price is published, but total station-level direct cost is not yet reproducible for all sites because blocking-fee amount/scope and a current discovery-price conflict remain unresolved.
